native_decision_cases: Decision review requires native authentication
Decision review requires decision permission rather than read-only access
Read-only decision review returns the entire selected set without writes
Review identifies permanent worker and placement numbers without disclosing pay or bill rates
Approval cannot bypass the browser review revision
Legacy approve action also requires the reviewed revision
An approval review cannot be reused for only a subset
A review cannot authorize the opposite decision
Invalid selection members cannot be silently discarded
Missing or foreign selection members refuse the entire review
Reviewed approval refuses changed time_entries.hours atomically
Reviewed approval refuses changed placement_rates.pay_rate atomically
Reviewed approval refuses changed people.first_name atomically
Final decision receipt failure rolls back every entry approval and header projection
Reviewed entry approval persists exactly the confirmed decision
Weekly rejection review displays the approved sibling without selecting it for rejection
Rejection requires a reason before any decision write
Overlong rejection reasons cannot partially change the week
A newly added weekly entry invalidates the previously displayed set
Late rejection receipt failure restores all rows, prior approvals and artifacts
Reviewed weekly rejection records the actual reviewer and reason
Rejection changes the complete pending set and preserves the approved sibling exactly
Repeated rejection does not create another decision or receipt
Reviewed entry decisions and weekly rejection create no financial execution
